stories.title: CeraVe partners with Dune for film marketing
stories.summary: L’Oréal brand CeraVe has entered its first film partnership, naming itself the Official Moisturizer of Arrakis. The campaign precedes the blockbuster’s release on 18 December. The brand is positioning its skincare products within the fictional desert landscape of the film.

stories.title: Burger King leans into customer feedback
stories.summary: CMO Joel Yashinsky says the chain is listening to customers to drive growth. This feedback-focused strategy has reportedly contributed to comparable sales increases for the restaurant brand.

stories.title: Amazon holiday ad features a long journey home
stories.summary: Amazon’s new holiday ad, Joy Delivered, depicts a woman thanking strangers with Amazon parcels during a difficult journey home. The campaign features a version of the Beatles’ Golden Slumbers. The ad runs like a movie, aiming to evoke emotion through a series of travel mishaps.

stories.title: LT Foods promotes Basmati rice flavour absorption
stories.summary: LT Foods has launched a campaign for Daawat Delight Basmati featuring chef Ranveer Brar. The ads suggest that the choice of rice influences the flavour of a meal. The campaign focuses on the product's flavour absorption proposition, claiming it makes every dish very very nice.

stories.title: HSBC Mutual Fund targets mid-cap perceptions
stories.summary: HSBC Mutual Fund has launched a digital campaign to explain growth prospects for mid-cap companies. Using a fictional snack business as a narrative device, the campaign aims to distinguish established mid-sized firms from early-stage start-ups to potential investors.

stories.title: Pee Safe campaign targets toilet hygiene
stories.summary: Pee Safe has launched a World Toilet Day campaign featuring retired Major Rishabh Singh Sambyal. The initiative encourages sanitising toilet seats in public and shared spaces. Founder Vikas Bagaria noted that while many people recognise shared toilets are not safe, few take action to address the risk.

stories.title: KFC India uses matchmaking drama for Korean range
stories.summary: KFC India has released a campaign film for its Korean Dunked range set during a traditional matchmaking meeting. The narrative uses family drama and sauce-related accidents to promote the product's sauce-led proposition. The campaign is titled Drip Happens.

stories.title: Hilary Rhoda promotes festive self-expression
stories.summary: Beauty brand Hilary Rhoda has partnered with actor Adah Sharma for its festive campaign. The brand is encouraging consumers to move away from minimalism toward bolder beauty choices. The company stated it chose a celebrity who relates to consumers rather than a conventional association.

stories.title: Joy Personal Care launches multi-platform campaign
stories.summary: Joy Personal Care has launched two campaigns featuring actor Tamannaah for its Honey and Almonds body lotion. The brand is using a theatrical approach, personifying the lotion as a romantic hero with a voiceover by Piyush Mishra. The storytelling is tailored to different content consumption habits.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip adopts Bonnie and Clyde theme for sale
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip has launched a campaign featuring Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh as a criminal couple. The ads promote the Travel ka Muhurat Sale, which covers flights, hotels and cabs. The company is using the theme to highlight its biggest sale of the year.

stories.title: Eureka Forbes links air quality to relationship drama
stories.summary: Eureka Forbes has launched a campaign featuring actors portraying a couple breaking up. The film reveals the separation is caused by toxic indoor air rather than interpersonal issues. The company claims its Aeroguard Air Purifier can remove toxic air within 10 minutes.

stories.title: 72andSunny appoints new New York CEO
stories.summary: Rebecca Pagis has been named CEO of 72andSunny New York following agency layoffs in October. Pagis joins from WPP, where she was North American president of Design Bridge and Partners. The agency is attempting to position its New York office as a growth engine.

stories.title: Publicis Media hires Rohin Desai
stories.summary: Rohin Desai has joined Publicis Media as senior vice president. He previously served as chief client officer for media buying at Madison World. His background includes leadership roles at Enterr10 Television, Bharat Media and Entertainment Group and Mindshare India.

stories.title: Viral Pitch names Adish Rai group president
stories.summary: Influencer marketing agency Viral Pitch has appointed Adish Rai as group president. Rai will oversee revenue and client strategy. He joins from Soulflower, where he led growth across retail and direct-to-consumer channels. The company combines an AI-powered platform with a managed agency model.

stories.title: WPP Media wins Branch International mandate
stories.summary: WPP Media has secured a performance marketing mandate for Branch International in India. The partnership aims to drive customer acquisition through digital marketing and data-led audience targeting. Branch International provides mobile-first financial services and credit solutions across emerging markets.

stories.title: Ogilvy India adds category lead
stories.summary: Anahita Brar has joined Ogilvy India WPP Open X as vice president and category lead. She brings 17 years of experience in advertising and brand services. Her previous roles include positions at Leo Burnett India, Dentsu Creative and MullenLowe Group Asia Pacific.

stories.title: CarDekho Group names new auto classifieds CEO
stories.summary: CarDekho Group has appointed Sudhir Pai as CEO of auto classifieds and group strategy. Pai previously led Magicbricks for 15 years. He will oversee the group's core auto-classifieds business, including CarDekho.com, ZigWheels and BikeDekho, while driving long-term strategic growth initiatives.

stories.title: IndiGo appoints brand marketing head
stories.summary: Vijay Nair has joined IndiGo as head of brand marketing. Nair has 19 years of experience in marketing strategy and communications. He previously held leadership roles at HT Media Group and The Walt Disney Company, where he led marketing for National Geographic Expeditions.

stories.title: BMW Group appoints Puneet Anand as director of corporate affairs
stories.summary: Puneet Anand has joined BMW Group as director of government relations, corporate affairs and CSR, based in Gurugram. He moves to the company after nearly 29 years at Hyundai Motor India, where he held various roles across service, sales planning and marketing. He announced the move on LinkedIn.

stories.title: Jamf appoints Tamanna Chanana as head of marketing
stories.summary: Tamanna Chanana has joined Jamf as head of marketing. She previously worked as a campaign, programme and events lead at Snowflake and held marketing roles at Whatfix and Truecaller. She announced her new position in a LinkedIn post, noting she is happy to start the role.

stories.title: Admatazz elevates Samyaak Jain to chief operating officer
stories.summary: Digital marketing agency Admatazz has promoted Samyaak Jain to chief operating officer after eight years with the firm. The agency also hired Dhruv Shah to lead its search, answer and generative engine optimisation vertical. Founder Yash Chandiramani noted that strong businesses are built by people who take ownership.

stories.title: Arun Nambiar joins Uber Advertising as head of agency for India
stories.summary: Arun Nambiar has joined Uber Advertising as head of agency for India. He previously served as India business head at Aleph Group and held various roles at Twitter. In his new role, he will lead national agency strategy and drive growth for the company in India.

stories.title: Havas Media Network India wins media mandate for Milky Mist’s Capella
stories.summary: Havas Media Network India has secured the integrated media mandate for Milky Mist’s luxury chocolate brand, Capella. The account will be managed by Havas Media India and its digital agency, PivotRoots. The win expands the network’s client roster in South India, which already includes Swiggy and Joyalukkas.

stories.title: YouTube Shopping launches in Australia
stories.summary: YouTube has launched its affiliate program in Australia with Amazon as a launch partner. The integration allows creators to tag products directly in content, offering what the company calls a frictionless discovery to checkout experience. The feature is available across Shorts, long-form videos, livestreams and connected TV screens.

stories.title: Meesho partners with YouTube Shopping to onboard 2 lakh creators
stories.summary: Meesho is partnering with YouTube Shopping to bring over 2 lakh creators into its affiliate network. Eligible creators can tag products from Meesho’s catalogue of 30 million items in their videos. Creators earn commissions on purchases, turning video views into checkout clicks for the e-commerce platform.

stories.title: YouTube to host 24-hour livestream for GTA 6 launch
stories.summary: YouTube will host a 24-hour global livestream to mark the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19. The broadcast features over 30 gaming creators and includes live gameplay and podcasts. The event begins with a pre-show hosted by RDCWorld on the night before the launch.

Meesho taps into YouTube shopping to onboard 2 lakh creator, opens affiliate access to over 30 million products
stories.summary: Meesho has partnered with YouTube Shopping to expand its creator-led commerce network, with plans to bring more than 2 lakh creators onto the platform over the coming months. The partnership will allow eligible YouTube creators to tag products from Meesho's catalogue directly in their videos, Shorts and livestreams, earning commissions

stories.title: Meesho partners with YouTube Shopping to boost creator commerce across India
stories.summary: Meesho has partnered with YouTube Shopping to create new commerce and income opportunities for creators across India, enabling eligible YouTube creators to tag Meesho products directly in their long-form videos, Shorts and livestreams. Creators with as few as 500 subscribers, subject to YouTube's eligibility criteria, can participate in the programme

stories.title: Influencers face new contract terms over AI digital replicas
stories.summary: The influencer economy is seeing a shift toward new compensation models as brands seek rights to reproduce creators' faces and voices using AI. Industry executives report that negotiations now include separate fees for digital replicas, though smaller creators often have limited control over how their identities are exploited.

stories.title: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links to Reels and feed posts
stories.summary: Instagram now allows U.S. creators to attach Amazon affiliate links to Reels and feed posts. Creators can include up to 30 products per Reel and 20 per post. The platform also added support for LTK and ShopMy collections. Instagram stated it does not take a cut of earnings.

stories.title: YouTube Partners With Rockstar Games On 24-Hour ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Launch Livestream
stories.summary: Platform YouTube Partners With Rockstar Games on 24-Hour ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Launch Livestream YouTube is partnering with Rockstar Games on creator programming and interactive features for the Nov. 19 release of “Grand Theft Auto VI.” The centerpiece is a 24-hour global livestream on the platform’s flagship channel, the company

stories.title: AI clones enter influencer contract talks as agencies push for separate fees, consent and usage limits
stories.summary: Indian influencer contracts are beginning to encounter a new commercial question: if a brand can recreate a creator's face or voice using artificial intelligence, does the original endorsement fee also buy the right to generate future performances? Executives say AI-related clauses are starting to appear in creator agreements, prompting negotiations

stories.title: Influencer Marketing Deals Are Negotiations Over More Than Reach
stories.summary: Influencer marketing deals are often described as a simple exchange: a brand pays for access to a creator’s audience. The reality is closer to a negotiation over behavior, distribution and future opportunity. That is the picture in Digiday’s account of a conversation between YSL Beauty’s Hadley Musinsky and Night’s Sophie

stories.title: FDJ United seeks injunction against Meta over fake casino ads
stories.summary: FDJ United has filed legal proceedings against Meta in Paris regarding 226 fake casino advertisements that misuse its brand. The case follows similar actions by Barrière and regulatory orders to block illegal gambling URLs. The move tests platform liability for the promotion of banned online casinos in France.

stories.title: FDJ United sues Meta over illegal casino ads
stories.summary: FDJ United has launched legal proceedings against Meta, alleging the platform hosts advertisements for unlicensed online casinos that reproduce its branding. Online casino products are prohibited in France, where the promotion of such services is also banned. FDJ estimates 80 million Europeans are exposed to illegal gambling annually.

stories.title: FDJ United takes Meta to court over fake ads
stories.summary: FDJ United is using a fast-track legal procedure to force Meta to remove advertisements for unlicensed online casinos that mimic its brands. The company reported 226 new illicit posts on Facebook and Instagram over four days in May. Many of the posts were identical to content previously reported.

stories.title: The Trade Desk loses three executives
stories.summary: Three senior executives are departing The Trade Desk amid the company's first year-over-year revenue decline since 2020. The firm recently cut 15 percent of its global workforce, incurring $44 million in restructuring charges. It projects $100 million in savings by 2027. The co-founder has returned to oversee technology.

stories.title: Ad buyers increase use of retail data for streaming
stories.summary: Programmatic agencies are seeing 14 percent year-over-year growth in requests to use retail data for streaming advertisements. Retailers are increasingly layering first-party shopping data into TV campaigns. Walmart and Amazon are both positioning streaming as a central component of their current advertising pitches to brands.

stories.title: Amazon reporting changes may reduce display ad impressions
stories.summary: Amazon has estimated that brands will see 63 percent fewer impressions for display ads across its retail properties, including product pages and search results. The platform is changing how it measures impressions, a shift that may impact performance and pricing benchmarks for advertisers starting in the new year.

stories.title: Brands shift toward live shopping for holidays
stories.summary: Brands are increasingly adopting live shopping channels to compete this holiday season. Livestream retail sales in the U.S. are expected to reach nearly $20 billion this year, with average annual spend per buyer growing 23 percent to $339.27. Last year's marketing playbook is reportedly no longer sufficient.

stories.title: Bustle Digital Group uses AI to influence recommendations
stories.summary: Bustle Digital Group is using AI measurement tools to help brands like Pampers and Innisfree appear in AI-generated recommendations. The publisher uses AI agents trained on its own content to generate creative briefs. The company says at least three brands have paid for the offering this year.

stories.title: Instagram tests long-form video discovery
stories.summary: Instagram is testing horizontal videos of up to 90 minutes, allowing creators to link multiple Reels to a single long-form session. The design mirrors Netflix, which uses short-form clips to route viewers toward widescreen content. Both platforms are competing for time spent on television screens.

stories.title: YouTube expands clip tool to Shorts
stories.summary: YouTube has expanded its video clips tool to allow creators to convert segments of long-form videos into vertical Shorts. Each Short created through the tool includes a clickable link to the original source video. The feature is intended to help podcast creators repurpose their existing long-form content.

stories.title: YouTube reaches record share of US TV viewing
stories.summary: YouTube accounted for 15.8 percent of all U.S. TV viewing time in August 2026, according to Nielsen. The figure is a record for the platform and more than double the 7.7 percent share held by Netflix. Hollywood has begun hiring YouTube executives to integrate creator-led content into film.

stories.title: AppLovin turnaround follows AI pivot
stories.summary: After its stock plunged 89 percent in 2022, AppLovin spent $7 billion on share buybacks and rebuilt its advertising technology around artificial intelligence. The resulting system, Axon 2, became the engine for a recovery that has pushed the company's valuation to more than $119 billion by November 2026.

stories.title: Deloitte Digital launches agentic marketing tools
stories.summary: Deloitte Digital has introduced new agentic tools designed to address marketing workflows. The consultancy says its move is a response to internal data indicating that the current pace of AI advancement is increasingly bumping up against existing organizational constraints within client companies.

stories.title: DataAtScale Launches Creator Brand Scan, an AI Influencer Vetting Tool for Brand Safety and Competitor Deals - EIN News
accessiBe unifies accessibility suite
stories.summary: accessiBe has integrated its accessFlow tool into a single agentic accessibility suite. The platform allows teams to manage accessibility across design, code, and production. The company claims the AI performs the remediation work while humans retain control over every change made to the web applications.

stories.title: DNB automates customer service with AI
stories.summary: Norway's DNB is using AI to automate routine customer service tasks and maintain interaction context. The bank reports that 95 percent of customers opt in to AI-supported conversations, and 80 percent of AI-generated summaries are accepted by advisors without edits. The system aims to reduce routine work.

stories.title: Commerce launches AI shopping assistant
stories.summary: Commerce.com has introduced a customizable AI storefront assistant for BigCommerce merchants. The tool is designed to provide personalized product discovery and shopping guidance to visitors. The launch is part of the company's broader strategy to turn shopper intent into conversions ahead of the holiday season.

stories.title: Brandlight adds ChatGPT business tools
stories.summary: Brandlight has launched new tools to help enterprises configure ChatGPT Business Agents and prepare product catalogs. The company emphasizes the need for cross-functional collaboration to succeed in AI-driven commerce. The tools are designed to help brands manage their presence within OpenAI's business-focused AI shopping experiences.

stories.title: millionways introduces Thorsten-4 model
stories.summary: millionways has released Thorsten-4, a model it describes as a foundational Large Psychology Model. The company claims the tool predicts human intent and reactions with 90 percent validated accuracy based on communication patterns. The lab is backed by investors from Meta, Pinterest, Apple, and the NFL.

stories.title: Kaltura releases Dynamic UI for conversational agents
stories.summary: Kaltura has announced the general availability of Dynamic UI, a tool designed to transform AI conversations into personalized, interactive digital experiences. The company claims the software uses lifelike avatars and multimedia to tailor content in real time. The interface is now available to its conversational agent users.

stories.title: New Engen debuts Bakery platform for creative assets
stories.summary: New Engen has launched Bakery, an AI platform designed to scale the production of advertising creative. The company says the tool connects performance data with ideation and scripting workflows. It claims to support the development of more than 5,000 creative assets in a single month.

stories.title: CMOs struggle to turn AI tools into business growth
stories.summary: Enterprise CMOs are reportedly finding that increased AI adoption has not yet translated into significant business growth. Many remain focused on task efficiency and pilot programs within functional silos. Some brands are now attempting to build AI systems that produce optimized content to break the cycle.
